summary: This clinical study looks at the timing of using a drug called liraglutide injection to help with weight loss in adults who still have obesity six months after having weight loss surgery. The study includes 100 participants and follows how well different start times for the drug work alongside diet and exercise guidelines. The trial is identified by NCT07374445.
